text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a modest gain felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding's risks and prospects.","Buying all five stocks after a decline did not prevent further losses; past price moves do not reliably signal what comes next.","Holding through falling markets can deepen losses, so I should periodically review risk and diversification instead of letting reluctance to realize a loss dictate my choices."]}
